description: Clock generator with three eight-step gate sequencers driven by it

params.text: Sets the tempo of the internal clock, 15 to 3840 BPM
Joins the three tracks into one 24-step sequence at 1x24, where only the T1 output carries pulses, or runs them as three independent eight-step tracks at 3x8
Restarts every track from its first step
Starts and stops the clock; while it is stopped the clock output and all three track outputs stay at 0V
Turns that step of the track on or off; an active step sends a pulse from its track output when the sequencer reaches it
Sets how many of the eight steps that track plays, 0 to 8; at 0 that track's output stays at 0V

inputs.text: Clocks all three tracks from an external source, and stops the internal clock while a cable is patched
A rising edge above 1V restarts every track from its first step

outputs.text: A 10V gate lasting half of each clock period, at 0V while the clock is stopped
Carries a 10V pulse, half a clock period long, when an active step of track 1 comes round; in 1x24 mode it carries the pulses of all 24 steps
Carries a 10V pulse, half a clock period long, when an active step of track 2 comes round, and stays at 0V in 1x24 mode
Carries a 10V pulse, half a clock period long, when an active step of track 3 comes round, and stays at 0V in 1x24 mode
